description: Canonical shape of the customDimensions emitted onto every native Application Insights availabilityResults row produced by platform-sitewatch-func and consumed by platform-status-web. This file is duplicated verbatim in both repositories (platform-sitewatch-func/contract/ and platform-status-web/contract/) and each repo has a test asserting its own code against these exact key names, so a rename on either side that isn't mirrored in the other repo's copy fails CI instead of drifting silently in production.

componentId.description: Dotted component identifier matching the status-web components.yaml component id, e.g. 'mx.api'. Must be prefixed with the owning site id and a dot.

siteId.description: Tenant/site identifier, one of the known site ids (currently 'xi', 'mx', 'dev'). Must match the first dot-delimited segment of componentId. Status-web always forces an additional customDimensions.siteId query filter to this value at query time - it never infers tenancy from componentId text alone.

region.description: Canonical lowercase Azure region string the probe executed in (e.g. 'uksouth', 'eastus', 'westeurope', 'swedencentral'), taken directly from the sitewatch-func REGION_NAME app setting. Falls back to the literal sentinel 'unknown' (never silently omitted) when REGION_NAME is missing/empty, so a probe with unresolvable region never accidentally satisfies a component's sla.expectedRegions check.

howToUpdate: 1. Update this file identically in both platform-sitewatch-func/contract/ and platform-status-web/contract/ (copy one over the other).
2. Update the producer emission code and its tests in platform-sitewatch-func (ExternalHealthCheck.cs, ComponentDimensionTests.cs, TestConfigValidator(Tests).cs).
3. Update the consumer query/filter code and its tests in platform-status-web (AvailabilityQueryBuilder(Tests).cs, TelemetryFilters(Tests).cs, ComponentStatusCalculator(Tests).cs).

4. Deploy platform-sitewatch-func (the producer) before platform-status-web/status-pages content starts depending on the new/changed dimension, so consumers never query for a dimension that isn't being emitted yet.
5. Both repos' 'contract fixture' tests load this file and assert their code's dimension names against it - re-run both test suites after any change.
